name: Imperial Javelineers
headerMeta: Heroic era · Javelin/Melee infantry · skirmisher · 240 leadership · T4 mastery
pitch: Javelin infantry that throws before closing to melee, excelling at pressuring squishy targets and poking units during downtime. The 2026-06-25 patch buffed their Flying Shield with +13% damage and Knockback, shifting them from pure poke to area control.

doctrines.name: Javelin Doctrine (Immobilize)
doctrines.effect: Javelins render enemies immobile for 1.5s. Mandatory per Amya.

doctrines.name: Javelin Doctrine (Block Break)
doctrines.effect: +300 javelin block break, +100 piercing dmg. Top pick.

doctrines.name: Polearm Doctrine
doctrines.effect: +60 piercing dmg, +180 piercing AP. Top pick.

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Amya calls Top Line for this unit - no extra detail given on why.

battleRole.positioning: Position in the push targeting important units, especially heroes. {1} Shield throw + kite/run-away is Imperial Javs' unique strength to trade favorably into certain matchups. {1}

matchups.siblings: Javelin Sergeants pierce 2 targets per javelin throw; Imperial Javs only hit one - Sergeants edge out vs grouped or stacked enemies. {2}

gaps: Fight ratings (Blob 4/Duel 2/Skirm 5/Flank 1) do exist in Amya's guide, but aren't shown on this page since this unit falls below the bar we use for showing that section - a deliberate choice, not missing data.
No house-card, house guide, or house-playbook mentions found anywhere - no house playstyle notes exist for this unit.
2026-06-25 patch added Knockback to Flying Shield; no source documents the new crowd-control use in practice yet.
Amya's guide was last edited 2026-05-26, before the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch - doctrine/build picks may be stale for the current season.

Earlier doctrine picks (Pierce Defense/Health Doctrine), both veterancy lines, formation, and controls-loop guidance turned out to be HandBananaPvP content about Javelin Sergeants, not this unit - dropped from this page. Only the pierce-count comparison between the two units carries over.
No dedicated Imperial Javelineers video exists; the HandBananaPvP guide that used to be linked here is actually a Javelin Sergeants guide, a different unit.

patch.summary: Base Piercing Damage 1201→1351; "Flying Shield" damage +13% and now applies Knockback
